job.job_title: Software Engineer at A FinTech Company
job.job_description:
Responsibilities

Design and develop scalable backend services
Contribute to system architecture and database design
Build reusable and maintainable application modules
Participate in the full software development lifecycle
Follow coding standards and documentation best practices
Explore and adopt new technologies

Preferred candidate profile

Experience with Java (Spring), Python (Django/FastAPI), or similar frameworks
Knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB
Understanding of OOP, design patterns, and microservices
Experience with Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ
Familiarity with building applications from scratch
Strong ownership, problem-solving, and learning mindset
